item.title: Road surface badly degraded, 18th August
item.description:
On Monument Gardens SE13 several sections of the road are composed of brick work. These sections have started to become badly degraded and there are now quite a lot of bricks which have been completely dislodged from the road surface. Some are still in position, just no longer secured, and some have come away from the road surface completely. This is creating a hazard for vehicles and a trip hazard for pedestrians. The bricks could also be used as projectiles by people. Additionally there are several areas of the tarmac part of the road which are now developing pot holes.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Monument Gardens, Hither Green, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
